description: This file defines authentication-related functions for user verification and token issuance. It includes functions to authenticate a user via email and password, and to generate access tokens for authenticated users. The file interacts with user models, security utilities, and database repository functions.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(session: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying their email and password. Retrieves user from database and checks password validity.

methods.name: str issue_token_for_user(user: User)
methods.description: Generates an access token for an authenticated user, embedding their user ID and email as claims.

ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(session: Session, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:$/
